data.body:
Experiment progress (Copilot CLI session, worktree filter-exp @ origin/main).

Harness built in git-ignored .expscratch/: common.py (corpus/AC parse/reduction), prepack.py (deterministic per-AC evidence packs: backtick+identifier+path token grep at ref, file_impact slices, referencing commits via git log --grep, cited-test function listings; 6KB/AC cap, thin-pack-on-missing, never synthesized), filter_pass.py (ONE boto3 Bedrock converse call, us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, temp 0, PASS-with-citations-or-ABSTAIN contract, FAIL coerced to ABSTAIN), run_verify.py (in-process verify_completion, source=local fetch=false, mock.patch.object on rebar._reads.show_ticket for description override/AC reduction + completion_verdict_cache.cache_dir to a per-run scratch dir).

EMERGENT FINDING 1: the completion verifier has a deterministic 8000-char description ADMISSION CAP — my first corpus (4ee2 iced-oniony-crustacean 11009ch, 850f loft-teeth-zip 10446ch) fast-FAILed 'description is N chars; accepts at most 8000' in ~1s, and a 45c1 adversarial edit that GREW the description to 8054 tripped it too. Any real corpus ticket must be <=8000 and adversarial edits length-neutral. Corpus reselected: 45c1 barky-metalled-bettong (task, 7998ch, 6 ACs), 3388 disparaged-parodistic-shrew (story, 7892ch, 10 ACs), 0e68 outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (epic, 7707ch, 7 ACs, 14 children — the with-children case). Adversarial variants: 45c1 ACs 0+3, 3388 AC 6, 0e68 ACs 2+5 rewritten to reference symbols proven absent at ref (MODULE_SPLIT_REGISTRY, legacy_reexports, merge_conflict_bodies/body_merge.py, NullProjectRouter, bridge migrate-projects).

Filter-pass results (6 calls, 5-19K tokens each): 45c1-real PASS 0/6; 45c1-adv PASS 1/6 (the genuinely-met trailer AC), both edited ACs ABSTAINED; 3388-real PASS 9/10; 3388-adv PASS 8/10 with the edited AC ABSTAINED; 0e68-real+adv PASS 0/7. FALSE-PASS COUNT SO FAR: 0. Coverage is strongly bimodal: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) can PASS from a static pack; ACs asserting runtime outcomes ('suites pass green', 'lint clean', 'second pass emits zero updates') or store-side artifacts (ticket comments) rationally ABSTAIN. 12 agentic runs (fallback+control per variant) now running sequentially.
